annotations.description: Playing Mountain instead of Inspiring Vantage on turn 1 is suboptimal. Later, if you play it as your third or later land, it might enter tapped. Mountain always enters untapped regardless of when you play it. By playing Mountain now, you risk having Inspiring Vantage enter tapped later. Additionally, with Hired Claw (a red 1-drop) in hand, either land would let you cast it, so there's no downside to playing Inspiring Vantage first — it produces red mana and preserves flexibility for future turns.
